user_query: I'm planning a trip to Tunisia and I want to exchange some currency. Can you provide me with the average exchange rate of Tunisian Dinar against USD and EUR? Also, fetch me the stock history of Google on February 1, 2023. Additionally, give me the equivalent words for the number 98765432.10 in English.

TaskList.description: Fetch the average exchange rate of Tunisian Dinar (TND) against USD and EUR.
Fetch the stock price history of Google (Alphabet Inc.) on February 1, 2023.
Convert the number 98765432.10 into its equivalent English words representation.
